result.reason: The six-month transition assistance at then-current rates meets the preferred duration and pricing, and certified deletion is included. However, data return is due within 30 days of Customer’s request rather than within 30 days after expiry or termination, allowing an indefinite delay if no request is made. The language also goes beyond the playbook by requiring continuation of affected Services on existing terms and free data export. Finally, placing the provision after the Section 18 INSURANCE heading, without a section number, creates structural ambiguity. The margin comment also includes an unsupported cross-reference issue, though that does not cure the operative language.
